description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_Munge' which extends 'HTMLPurifier_URIFilter'. It manages URL munging/filtering for the HTMLPurifier library, providing functions to prepare configuration, filter URLs, and create replacements for URL rewriting.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_Munge
classes.description: Class responsible for URL munging in HTMLPurifier, extends the base URL filter class, providing URL transformation functionalities based on configuration and context.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes URL filter with configuration settings, including target URL, URI parser, embedding options, and secret key.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters and potentially rewrites a given URI based on rules, context, and configuration. Checks scheme, host, and URL properties before transforming the URL.

methods.name: makeReplace
methods.description: Constructs replacement tokens used to munge URLs based on the URI and current execution context.
